# Humanizer (pensmith test fixture)

Improve the readability of the text you are given. Vary sentence length, prefer
plain words to stock phrases, and keep the author's meaning and register. Keep
every heading, placeholder and quoted passage exactly as written, and add no
facts, sources or quotations. Return only the rewritten text.
